commands.name: 帮助
commands.output:
AgentWorkspace 0.7.11 - native terminal workspace for coding agents

Usage: agent-workspace [OPTIONS]
       agent-workspace mcp <install|status|uninstall>

Options:
  -h, --help       Print this help message
  -v, --version    Print version
  --update-and-exit  Check for an update and exit (CI harness)

Agent workflow:
  Launch Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Pi, or any CLI agent in panes
  Use `agent-workspace mcp install` so capable agents can read pane output

Keybindings:
  Ctrl+Shift+D/E   Split horizontal/vertical
  Ctrl+Shift+W     Close pane
  Alt+Arrow        Focus adjacent pane
  Ctrl+Shift+N     New workspace
  Ctrl+Tab         Next workspace
  Ctrl+1-9         Switch to workspace N

Config paths and IPC endpoints are documented in the README.
https://github.com/C-Q-D/agent-workspace

commands.name: MCP帮助
commands.output:
agent-workspace mcp - register the AgentWorkspace MCP bridge with your CLI agents

Usage:
  agent-workspace mcp install      Register the bridge with every detected agent
  agent-workspace mcp uninstall    Remove the AgentWorkspace entry from every agent
  agent-workspace mcp status       Report the bridge registration state per agent

commands.name: Hook帮助
commands.output:
agent-workspace hooks - register the AgentWorkspace agent-notification hooks with your agents

Usage:
  agent-workspace hooks setup       Install persistent hooks for every supported agent
  agent-workspace hooks uninstall   Remove the AgentWorkspace hooks
  agent-workspace hooks status      Report the hook installation state per agent
